name: iw6
title: Call of Duty: Ghosts (IW6)
note: Addresses from the decrypted SP image (section raw offsets = RVAs). Stream primitives found 2026-09-25 by disassembly.

ghidra.epilogue_tags_note: the stream stack depth every top-level reader decrements in its inlined pop tail

rva_note: file_read(dst, n, 0) copies zone bytes; there is no string primitive: Load_XString (load_string, load_string_ptr) and 38 inlined strlen loops call file_read one byte at a time, which stream.byte_strings folds back into one string read. find_asset is DB_FindXAssetHeader: it waits on locks with Sleep, so it must never run.

asset_dispatch.note: the game's asset loop: varXAsset = &list[i]; Load_XAsset(false). Load_XAsset switches on the type.

release.note: thresholds the release check enforces before these tables ship; occurrences_min set once the first full record exists

zone_load.note: the tail of DB_LoadXFile (0x14028fa47): the 40-byte XAssetList is raw-read into a static, then under push(3) the script strings and XGlobals load through their own readers, then under push(3) the asset array is allocated, Load_Stream-ed, and each entry dispatched with varXAsset = &list[i]; Load_XAsset(false)

crt_note: IAT thunks (jmp [rip+x]) the emulator performs itself: their targets are DLLs the dump does not contain. Names from the shipped exe's import table.
